method: Built-in image generation; ImageMagick nearest-neighbor normalization
base: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE standalone production game building sprite for Mindustry. Subject: SUBJECT. Strict top-down orthographic roof/cutaway PLAN view, NOT isometric. Square 2x2 footprint nearly fills canvas, transparent outside. Pixel art with bold clusters readable at 64x64 logical pixels, rendered large with crisp pixel edges. Consistent vanilla Mindustry palette: charcoal #292933 outlines, slate gray metal #626271, gray #9999a5 upper-left bevels, muted tan #c9a675 trim; restrained subject accents. Industrial realistic equipment layout, distinct silhouette within square beveled foundation, small conveyor input slot centered on lower edge. No text, no letters, no scenery, no humans, no perspective walls, no external shadow. Avoid fine noise, smooth gradients, glossy 3D rendering. One building only.
